title: Sam Altman responds to ‘incendiary’ New Yorker article after attack on his home
raw_text: The OpenAI CEO's new blog post responds to both an apparent attack on his home and an in-depth New Yorker profile raising questions about his trustworthiness.

title: Anthropic temporarily banned OpenClaw’s creator from accessing Claude
raw_text: This ban took place after Claude's pricing changed for OpenClaw users last week.

title: Stalking victim sues OpenAI, claims ChatGPT fueled her abuser’s delusions and ignored her warnings
raw_text: OpenAI ignored three warnings that a ChatGPT user was dangerous — including its own mass-casualty flag — while he stalked and harassed his ex-girlfriend, a new lawsuit alleges.

title: TechCrunch is heading to Tokyo — and bringing the Startup Battlefield with it
raw_text: SusHi Tech 2026 is zeroing in on four technology domains reshaping society: AI, Robotics, Resilience, and Entertainment. Expect live demos of humanoid robots, sessions on autonomous driving's software revolution, deep dives into cyber defense and climate tech, and candid conversations about how AI is rewriting the global music and anime industries.

title: ChatGPT finally offers $100/month Pro plan
raw_text: OpenAI announced on Thursday something that power users have been asking for: a $100/month plan. Previously, subscriptions jumped from $20 to $200 per month.

title: Florida AG announces investigation into OpenAI over shooting that allegedly involved ChatGPT
raw_text: ChatGPT had reportedly been used to plan the attack that killed two and injured five at Florida State University last April. The family of one victim has said that they plan to sue OpenAI over the incident.

title: After data breach, $10B-valued startup Mercor is having a month
raw_text: After falling victim to a hacker, Mercor is facing lawsuits and reportedly losing big-name customers.

title: Meta AI app climbs to No. 5 on the App Store after Muse Spark launch
raw_text: The app was ranking No. 57 on the App Store just before Meta AI's new model launched. Now it's No. 5 — and rising.

title: Is Anthropic limiting the release of Mythos to protect the internet — or Anthropic?
raw_text: Anthropic said this week that it limited the release of its newest model, dubbed Mythos, because it is too capable of finding security exploits in software relied upon by users around the world. Are real cybersecurity concerns a cover for a bigger problem at the frontier lab?

title: Google and Intel deepen AI infrastructure partnership
raw_text: The two tech giants are looking to co-develop custom chips, at a time when demand for CPUs is high due to a growing global shortage.

title: Sierra’s Bret Taylor says the era of clicking buttons is over
raw_text: Last month, Sierra launched Ghostwriter, an agent designed to build other agents. With this “agent as a service” tool, the startup intends to replace traditional click-based web applications with natural language. Users simply describe what they need, prompting Ghostwriter to autonomously create and deploy a specialized agent to execute the task.

title: Amazon CEO takes aim at Nvidia, Intel, Starlink, more in annual shareholder letter
raw_text: Andy Jassy's annual shareholder letter reads something like a diss track to a wide range of competitors as he defends spending $200 billion in capex.

title: Poke makes using AI agents as easy as sending a text
raw_text: Poke brings AI agents to everyday users via text message by handling tasks and automations without complex setup, apps, or technical know-how.

title: AWS boss explains why investing billions in both Anthropic and OpenAI is an OK conflict
raw_text: AWS has an ingrained culture of handling competition, he explained, because the cloud giant also competes with its partners.

title: Tubi is the first streamer to launch a native app within ChatGPT
raw_text: Tubi becomes the first streaming service to offer an app integration within ChatGPT, the AI chatbot that millions of users turn to for answers.

title: Astropad’s Workbench reimagines remote desktop for AI agents, not IT support
raw_text: Astropad’s Workbench lets users remotely monitor and control AI agents on Mac Minis from iPhone or iPad, with low-latency streaming and mobile access.

title: New ways to balance cost and reliability in the Gemini API
raw_text: Google is introducing two new inference tiers to the Gemini API, Flex and Priority, to balance cost and latency.

title: Create, edit and share videos at no cost in Google Vids
raw_text: New AI capabilities are coming to Google Vids, powered by Lyria 3 and Veo 3.1, like high-quality video generation at no cost and more.
